scope: One disposition for every known BBB native entrypoint. Direct execution requires oracle output checked against a fixture consumed by Rust. Reviewed static equivalence is separately identified; fuzzy structural similarity alone remains pending.

entrypoints.rationale: Full static body review: DOS storage/memory-provider initialization is replaced by owned Rust memory and explicit asset roots. No DOS driver or fallback temporary-directory ABI is ported; this is not native-execution evidence. Establish DOS data/stack and require mouse driver; SDL application setup replaces real-mode mouse presence/error path. Establish global/resource segments, acquire conventional heap, locate environment; owned Rust allocation and process environment replace PSP state. Parse DOS peripheral/write-root switches; seed clock, choose roots, install error/timer hooks and set VGA. Modern options preserve explicit writable root, not hardware switches. Calibrate retrace, initialize sound and pointer bounds/position, create memory pools. SDL/wgpu/audio and owned cache supply host services. Program speaker divider then call complete game lifecycle. Speaker pulse semantics live in typed timer/audio owners. Release pools, stop timer, restore video and free heap before DOS process exit; owned modern host teardown replaces vectors and segment handles.

Allocate six runtime arenas and their view offsets; owned framebuffers/resources replace segmented aliases. Prepare writable files, archive index, CD audio, MANU3 and logical320x200 viewport; open panorama and load save directory. Select/configure audio driver once; SDL setup replaces DOS driver resources and vectors. Load cartography, set startup presentation/UI/redraw, randomize scene, run line0, load default bank/backbuffer and initial pointer. Saturating simulation-clock decrement even while paused, arm eight-tick budget, reset hover/remap choice, dispatch input. Poll pointer only when unpaused and UI mask8 clear; consume pending bits preserving authored two-phase pointer latches; otherwise restore locked position. Exit gate, pause HUD and paused restart; pointer edges then BBB right-click handler; nonstartup VM negative result exits. Pending profile waits on five BBB blockers only. Load, enable/execute VM and rebuild records; initial profile alone refreshes access/HUD and redraw state. No C2 marks frame available. Presentation owner chooses hold, word choice, subtitle or deferred menu from exact latches. Completed hold arms word choice; BBB resumes VM while countdown nonzero iff C2 clear; timeout/rightclick resolves holds and text request. No presentation/hold/ship clears text ownership; active scene/sequence without secondary request enters line selection. Request/countdown selects menu selector+9 or idle8; otherwise producer-consumer difference restarts retained owner/menu buffer, preserving queued C2. Pending completion audio stops old stream, loads authored completion voice with volume120 and starts it. Ordered bridge, confirmation, audio, ship/scene, save/load, text-speed and simulation-speed updates. Clear chatter/voice when no primary text request or secondary pending. Ordinary chooser before framebuffer submission; inventory chooser after. Inline menu, subtitles, MANU3 and palette maintenance; pace then present; repeat. Finish queues, stop audio, run credits, stop/shutdown audio; release optional transient voice. Release optional music/archive-index files, delete startup transient files, restore source root and close archive. Explicit-root cleanup replaces DOS handles.
